title: Functions vs readLine()
instructions: Why do we use function parameters instead of `readLine()` in the playground exercises?

options.text: The playground doesn't support interactive console input, and functions are more testable and reusable
Function parameters are slower but more accurate
readLine() only works with numbers, not strings

explanation: readLine() is a real Kotlin function, but it requires an interactive console. The Kotlin Playground doesn't support that. Using function parameters is actually a better pattern -- it makes code more testable, reusable, and mirrors how real robot code receives sensor data.
